tasks.title: Create design system tokens, cn() helper and visual direction ADR
acceptance: src/index.css declares Tailwind 4 @theme tokens for exactly one font family (--font-sans), one accent color scale, neutral surface/text colors, a type scale and tinted shadows (shadow color derived from the accent or neutral hue, no pure-black or neon glow)
Accent and text tokens meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and UI) against the background tokens, with ratios listed in the ADR
src/lib/cn.ts exports a typed cn() class helper and is the only class-joining helper in src/
docs/adr/0001-visual-direction.md exists with status, decision (font, accent, radius rounded-2xl, shadows, light/dark stance) and a 'Quando reabrir' section
yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass

tasks.title: Set up folder structure, page metadata and favicon; remove Vite template leftovers
acceptance: Folders src/components/, src/sections/, src/content/ and src/lib/ exist (with real files or a .gitkeep), and src/App.css, src/assets/react.svg and public/vite.svg are removed with no remaining references

index.html has lang="en", title 'Matheus Costa Francisco · Senior Front-End Software Engineer', a meta description built only from cv.md facts, and Open Graph tags og:type, og:title, og:description and og:image (og:url omitted until the domain is defined)
A favicon that is not the Vite logo is served from public/ and referenced in index.html
yarn typecheck, yarn lint and yarn build pass

tasks.title: Create typed content modules from cv.md
acceptance: src/content/ exports typed modules (types declared, no any) for profile (name, role, stack, location, email, LinkedIn, tagline, summary), experience, products, skills, education, certification and languages
experience lists the 5 positions from cv.md in reverse chronological order with the exact dates and bullets, including the Soluti promotion to Senior in Apr 2023
No phone number appears anywhere in src/ (grep for '99991' and '+55' returns nothing)
WoodFlow public link is represented as an explicit [REVISAR] value and no fact absent from cv.md is introduced
yarn typecheck and yarn build pass

tasks.title: Build page layout and navigation
acceptance: App.tsx renders a header with nav, a <main> landmark and a footer; the template placeholders (including 'Depoimentos') are gone
A skip link to #main is the first focusable element and becomes visible on focus

Nav links point to #about, #experience, #products, #skills, #education and #contact, work by keyboard, and collapse into an accessible menu (aria-expanded, Esc closes) at 375px without horizontal scroll
Page wrapper uses min-h-[100dvh] (no h-screen) and nav items implement hover, focus-visible, :active and disabled-safe styles via tokens from T-001

tasks.title: Build hero section
acceptance: Hero renders name as the page's only <h1>, role, tagline, stack and location, all read from src/content/
Profile photo from content/assets/profile.jpg renders with descriptive alt text and explicit width/height
Primary CTA links to #contact (or mailto) and secondary CTA links to the LinkedIn URL with rel="noopener noreferrer"
Layout has no horizontal scroll at 375px and stacks photo and text on mobile

tasks.title: Build about/summary section
acceptance: Section #about renders the Summary text from cv.md via src/content/, with an <h2> heading
The section is reachable from the nav link and is a labelled region (aria-labelledby pointing to its heading)
No text in the section is hardcoded in the component

tasks.title: Build experience timeline section
acceptance: Section #experience lists the 5 positions from cv.md in reverse chronological order (AsapFlow first, RKM Support last) as an ordered list
Each item shows role, company, period, location/context and all bullets from cv.md; the Soluti item shows the Apr 2023 promotion
Dates use <time> elements and the timeline remains readable at 375px without horizontal scroll

tasks.title: Build contact section and footer
acceptance: Section #contact shows the e-mail as a mailto link, the LinkedIn link and the location 'Piracicaba, Brazil · Remote', all from src/content/
No phone number is rendered
Footer shows the name and current year and contains no placeholder links
External links use rel="noopener noreferrer" and all links have visible focus styles

tasks.title: Build products section (Manda Aí, WoodFlow)
acceptance: Section #products renders Manda Aí and WoodFlow with description and stack exactly as in cv.md
Manda Aí links to https://mandai.ia.br with rel="noopener noreferrer"
WoodFlow shows a visible [REVISAR] marker instead of a link while its public URL is undefined
Cards use rounded-2xl and tokenized tinted shadows and implement hover and focus-visible states

tasks.title: Build skills section
acceptance: Section #skills renders the 5 skill groups from cv.md, each with an accessible heading and its items as a list
All items come from src/content/ and none is added beyond cv.md
Layout wraps without horizontal scroll at 375px

tasks.title: Build education, certification and languages section
acceptance: Section #education lists the 4 courses from cv.md with institution and period, the FIAP MBA marked as expected
The AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification and both languages with levels (Portuguese native, English intermediate B1/B2) are rendered
All data comes from src/content/

tasks.title: Add subtle entrance animations respecting prefers-reduced-motion
acceptance: Sections animate in with opacity/transform only (no layout-shifting properties), duration at most 400ms
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, no animation or transition runs and content is visible immediately
Content is visible without JavaScript-dependent animation state (no section stays hidden if the observer fails)

tasks.title: Add 404 page
acceptance: yarn build produces dist/404.html using the same font and color tokens as the main page
The 404 page has lang="en", a <main> landmark, an <h1> and a link back to /
It has no horizontal scroll at 375px

tasks.title: Optimize profile image delivery
acceptance: The hero photo is served in a modern format (WebP or AVIF) with a JPEG fallback via <picture>, at sizes no larger than its rendered dimensions x2
The hero image has fetchpriority="high" and no loading="lazy"; any other image below the fold uses loading="lazy"
Total image bytes for the hero in dist/ are smaller than content/assets/profile.jpg
